recognize_zh: 中央一顆細胞的細胞質塞滿大小不一、淡藍色圓形空泡狀球體（Russell bodies），像一串葡萄，偏心小核被推到一側，即為 Mott cell；旁邊還有一顆偏心核、核周淡染區（perinuclear hof）的漿細胞。
features: Plasma cell with cytoplasm distended by numerous round, pale blue-gray globules of varying size (Russell bodies), giving a grape-cluster (morula) appearance
Small, eccentric round nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin displaced to the cell edge
Adjacent plasma cell with eccentric nucleus, deep basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hof
Background marrow aspirate with erythroid precursors, lymphocytes, abundant platelets and fat droplets
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed hematopoietic background with erythroid precursors, scattered lymphocytes and fat droplets. A single large plasma cell has cytoplasm packed with multiple round, pale blue immunoglobulin globules (Russell bodies) compressing an eccentric nucleus, consistent with a Mott cell. A nearby plasma cell shows an eccentric nucleus and perinuclear hof. Mott cells are not specific for neoplasia; in this post-transplant myeloma setting, plasma cell quantification and clonality studies are required. Findings are consistent with a Mott cell (plasma cell with Russell bodies).

ddx.vs: A macrophage contains ingested red cells or nuclear debris of variable color and has a larger, reniform nucleus, whereas Mott cell globules are uniform, pale blue, non-refractile immunoglobulin spheres in a plasma cell.
Storage cells have fine wrinkled or foamy cytoplasm without discrete round globules and lack the clock-face plasma cell nucleus.
Dutcher bodies are intranuclear (overlying the nucleus) immunoglobulin pseudoinclusions, whereas Russell bodies here are multiple cytoplasmic globules.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with small empty lipid vacuoles and a blastic nucleus with nucleoli, not large pale globules around a mature plasma cell nucleus.
